# Homepage — Southern Signal visual review

Captured from the production static build with headless Chromium on 2026-10-11. The hero uses the real Neon City HorneroOS capture from the showroom catalogue; its capture provenance remains visible.

- `homepage-signal-desktop-light.png` — 1440×1000, light color scheme with the Light option selected.
- `homepage-signal-desktop.png` — 1440×1000, dark color scheme with the Dark option selected.
- `homepage-signal-mobile.png` — 390×844, light color scheme with the System option selected. The desktop capture and its provenance lead the first screen before the long-form introduction.

These are website review captures, not HorneroOS desktop screenshots. The product capture shown within them retains its own provenance on the page.
